title: Lapis Lamp
description:
The Lapis Lamp emits a light level of 15. Unlike normal light sources, it does not stop hostile mobs from spawning: they can still spawn within 4 blocks of it, even where it is bright. On Peaceful difficulty nothing hostile spawns, as usual.

This also applies to mobs from spawners, but not to mobs spawned with spawn eggs.

properties.label: Effect
properties.value: Hostile mobs can still spawn within 4 blocks
